flags.title: Arithmetic of the High-confidence odds window (brief-level irregularity)
flags.detail: The brief requires High picks to have p > 70% AND to sit between -250 and +10000. Those constraints overlap only in the fair-price band [-250, -233.33] (p between 70.0% and 71.43%), a window about 1.4 American-odds points wide. Selections above 71.43% are necessarily priced shorter than -250 and are therefore published as 'Medium (chalk cap)' with disclosure, never silently promoted to High. This desk treats the window as a hard constraint and reports the consequence.
